reason: I do buy things I see on Facebook, but $36 for a tinted balm from a brand with zero reviews is a lot to hand over to a website I've never heard of. I'd scroll past this one and wait to see if other women my age say it actually works.
objection: A 365-day guarantee sounds lovely, but I've been burned before by companies that make returns a runaround or sneak in charges. With no reviews I have no idea if this small brand will actually honor it, or if the pink just looks the same on everybody.
would_change_my_mind: Real reviews and before-and-after photos from women over 60, ideally from someone I'd trust, showing it doesn't dry out or bleed and that people really got their refunds.
